decision_log.decision: Place the built-in desk and both shelving towers on the north (window) wall.
decision_log.rationale: Puts daylight on the worktop, satisfies the same-wall requirement, and lets the towers frame the window band as one piece of joinery.

decision_log.decision: Window band 3.00 m wide between the towers (71% of the north wall), sill 0.90 m above the 0.74 m worktop.
decision_log.rationale: Exceeds the 50% minimum while leaving solid wall for the towers; the 0.16 m gap below the sill takes a pinboard strip.

decision_log.decision: Entry door on the east wall near the south-east corner, hinged on the south jamb.
decision_log.rationale: The leaf folds back toward the south wall, the view on entry is to the window wall, and the swing quadrant sits in a corner no furniture needs.

decision_log.decision: Storage as a floor-to-ceiling built-in wardrobe on the east wall, flush with the east tower.
decision_log.rationale: Meets the no-freestanding-wardrobe rule and completes an L of joinery with the north wall; its doors stay 0.10 m clear of the entry door swing.

decision_log.decision: Daybed in the south-west corner with head to the west wall and back to the south wall.
decision_log.rationale: A 1.20 x 2.00 daybed sleeps one and reads as a sofa by day; drawers underneath add storage and leave the room centre open.

decision_log.decision: Circulation routed as a 0.90 m clear path from the door along the south side, past the wardrobe, along the daybed's open side to the desk.
decision_log.rationale: Keeps a continuous 1.60-1.80 m open floor between daybed and desk; the bed and the desk are both reached directly from the path.

decision_log.decision: Palette of pale oak floor, chalk-white walls and bottle-green matt joinery with oak worktop.
decision_log.rationale: Dark matt joinery gives the low room depth without reflection; no mirrored panels and no gloss on any wall surface.

decision_log.decision: Layered lighting with concealed pelmet task light, tower strips, wall reading light and two surface-mounted discs.
decision_log.rationale: A 2.40 m ceiling rules out pendants in the walk zone; task light at the desk and reading light at the bed cover both uses.

decision_log.decision: Freestanding desk chair and rug rather than built-in seating at the desk.
decision_log.rationale: The chair can be pulled to the daybed when the room is used as a bedroom; the rug anchors the open floor without blocking drawers.
